meta.title: Shinobi 1987 | Martí Sabaté
meta.description: Recreation of the video game Shinobi (1987) using C++ and SDL2.

content.title: Shinobi (1987)
about: Shinobi is basically a horizontal scrolling action game, in which the player moves to the right while taking down the enemies in his path, using his shuriken, a ninjato, and special ninja magic. Also an important objective is to rescue the kidnapped ninja children
Developed as the first project of the Video Game Development degree, using only C++ and SDL2.
learnings: First simulation of a real group project
First serious project without using a game engine
Recreated techniques used in arcade games
Learned how to build a custom physics system
Learned how to develop a custom 2D animation system
